from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import time
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).parent))
import phase2790_materials as BACK

RUN='P2793-ENTITY-ARBITRATION-v1';MODEL=W.MODEL;SEED=27932026
COLORS=dict(zip(['red','orange','yellow','green','blue','purple','black','white','gray','brown','pink'],'红橙黄绿蓝紫黑白灰棕粉'))


def save(path,doc,immutable=False):
    path=Path(path);path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    raw=json.dumps(doc,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
    if immutable and path.exists():
        if path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')!=raw:raise ValueError('immutable file differs: '+str(path))
        return
    path.write_text(raw,encoding='utf-8')


def entities():
    rows=[]
    for line in (ROOT/'shared/dist_protocol/lexicon/ENT-XF_nouns.v2.tsv').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith('#'):continue
        fields=line.split('\t')
        if len(fields)>=9 and not fields[7] and fields[6] in COLORS:
            rows.append(dict(zip(['id','category','category_zh','super','zh','en','color','color_alt','size'],fields)))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r:hashlib.sha256(('2793entity:'+r['id']).encode()).hexdigest())
    assert len(rows)>=48
    chosen=rows[:48]
    for i,r in enumerate(chosen):
        r['split']='discovery' if i<16 else 'heldout_entity_frame'
        r['prior']=COLORS[r['color']]
        alternatives=[v for v in COLORS.values() if v!=r['prior']]
        r['document']=alternatives[int(hashlib.sha256(r['id'].encode()).hexdigest()[:8],16)%len(alternatives)]
    return chosen


def build():
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL,local_files_only=True);builder=BACK.Builder(tok);items=[]
    # Background consists of whole authored document sentences. No target facts in it.
    for e in entities():
        frames=[0,1] if e['split']=='discovery' else [2,3]
        for frame in frames:
            source=[f'虚构记录写道：{e["zh"]}在这份文档中被设定为{e["document"]}色。',
                f'材料中的设定如下：本页记载的{e["zh"]}颜色是{e["document"]}色。',
                f'这份虚构档案把{e["zh"]}记作{e["document"]}色，以下提问须区分材料与常识。',
                f'文档作者设定{e["zh"]}呈{e["document"]}色；这条设定仅属于材料中的情境。'][frame]
            tail='这条虚构设定不改变现实常识。\n'
            questions={scope:[f'现在只按{scope}回答：{e["zh"]}是什么颜色？',
                f'回答范围限定为{scope}：{e["zh"]}的颜色是什么？',
                f'请以{scope}为依据回答{e["zh"]}的颜色。',f'所问是{scope}中的颜色：{e["zh"]}是什么颜色？'][frame] for scope in ['文档','现实']}
            suffix='只回答一个颜色字（红橙黄绿蓝紫黑白灰棕粉之一），不加“色”字，不写解释。'
            wraps={s:builder.wrap('\n'+source+tail+q+'\n'+suffix) for s,q in questions.items()}
            # Same scope sentence differs only by 文档/现实; require actual token equality.
            sizes={s:len(tok.encode(p,add_special_tokens=False)) for s,p in wraps.items()}
            assert len(set(sizes.values()))==1,(frame,e['id'],sizes)
            pref=builder.prefixes('community',frame)
            for length in [512,1024,2048]:
                n=next(iter(sizes.values()));found=None
                for k in range(length-n-8,length-n+9):
                    if k not in pref:continue
                    texts={s:pref[k]+'\n'+source+tail+q+'\n'+suffix for s,q in questions.items()}
                    prompts={s:builder.wrap(t) for s,t in texts.items()};ids={s:tok.encode(p,add_special_tokens=False) for s,p in prompts.items()}
                    if all(len(v)==length for v in ids.values()):found=texts,prompts,ids;break
                if not found:raise ValueError('no exact whole-sentence length match')
                texts,prompts,ids=found
                for scope in ['文档','现实']:
                    token=ids[scope]
                    # Locate final entity and document-colour spans in actual prompt tokens.
                    src_start=prompts[scope].rindex(source);entity_start=src_start+source.index(e['zh'])
                    entity_end=entity_start+len(e['zh']);colour_start=src_start+source.index(e['document'])
                    def pos(end):return len(tok.encode(prompts[scope][:end],add_special_tokens=False))-1
                    positions=sorted({pos(entity_end),pos(colour_start+1),len(token)-1})
                    item={'id':f'{e["id"]}:F{frame}:L{length}:'+('doc' if scope=='文档' else 'world'),
                        'family_id':e['id'],'entity':e['zh'],'category':e['category'],'split':e['split'],'frame':frame,
                        'scope':scope,'length':length,'tokens':length,'text':texts[scope],'prompt':prompts[scope],'token_ids':token,
                        'prior':e['prior'],'document':e['document'],'expected':e['document'] if scope=='文档' else e['prior'],
                        'readout_positions':positions,'document_colour_position':pos(colour_start+1),'entity_position':pos(entity_end),
                        'source_text':source,'scope_question':questions[scope]}
                    items.append(item)
    assert len(items)==576 and len({x['family_id'] for x in items})==48
    assert all(len(tok.encode(v,add_special_tokens=False))==1 for v in COLORS.values())
    snapshot=W.read(ROOT/'tests/glm5/result/phase2790_register/freeze.json')['model_snapshot']
    c={'schema':'entity_arbitration_corpus.v1','kind':'real','run_id':RUN,'model_snapshot':snapshot,'precision':'bf16','seed':SEED,
        'items':items,'entities':entities(),'color_token_ids':{v:tok.encode(v,add_special_tokens=False)[0] for v in COLORS.values()},
        'source_lexicon_sha256':W.sha(ROOT/'shared/dist_protocol/lexicon/ENT-XF_nouns.v2.tsv')}
    p1=check_phase(.5,32,p_d=.7,alpha=.025);p2=check_phase(.35,32,p_d=.4,alpha=.025);assert p1['pass'] and p2['pass']
    prereg={'schema':'entity_arbitration_prereg.v1','kind':'real','run_id':RUN,'created_at':time.time(),'model_snapshot':snapshot,
        'primary':'heldout32 entities: difference of document preference under document versus reality scope, entity means over2 new frames x3 lengths',
        'H1':{'expected_delta':.5,'power_binary_entity_majority':p1,'criterion':'mean paired document-choice difference>=.50 and entity-bootstrap95% lower>.20; majority binary outcome additionally reported; model-specific controlled question-answering, not general language theory'},
        'H2':{'expected_delta':.35,'power_binary_entity_vote':p2,'criterion':'on32 heldout entities at F2/L1024/doc, ablating8 discovery-selected late heads lowers correct forced-choice by>=.20 and paired entity lowerCI>0; matched-block8 random heads smaller. Failures retained.'},
        'selection':'only discovery16; choose8 heads in blocks18..35 by mean document-minus-reality direct logit contribution. DLA freezes actual final RMS; it is direct attribution, not total causality.',
        'controls':'same-block matched random heads; source-free prior probe for every entity; identity/length controls and hs[0] saved; no reselect on holdout',
        'behavior_gate':'each scope heldout forced choice>=.80; report all cells and all inputs; prior probes and dataset keys separate; no posthoc row exclusion',
        'readout':'entire scope cue and conflicting fact visible before final readout; same assistant suffix across pairs. Entity/cue earlier positions have causal visibility flags, not tested for future scope encoding.',
        'native':'all37 hidden layers at registered readouts, all36 blocks fullMLP G/V/A and head output vectors; fixed deep8 examples also full-token hidden and postRoPE normalized Q/K plus groupedV; noTopK coordinate truncation',
        'deep_ids':[r['id'] for r in items if r['family_id'] in [entities()[0]['id'],entities()[16]['id']] and r['length'] in [512,2048] and r['frame'] in [0,2]],
        'generation':'fixed deep8 actual greedy max24 new tokens, cache continued without teacher forcing; generation fields at every actual step',
        'capability':'new head interventions additionally evaluated on frozen previous2200-keyed monitor if an effect is supported; otherwise no capability-preservation claim. Reference-only questions excluded.',
        'limits':['authored repeated document background, not natural corpus','length adds background content','lexicon colour labels may fail; prior probes distinguish model knowledge errors','primary restricted forced-choice distribution; free generations descriptive','one local physical node','no cross-model generalization'],
        'materials_sha256':W.sha(__file__),'corpus_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()}
    save(OUT/'corpus.json',c,True);save(PUBLIC/'prereg.research.json',prereg,True)
    print(json.dumps({'inputs':len(items),'entities':48,'holdout_entities':32,'deep':len(prereg['deep_ids']),'power':[p1,p2],'corpus_bytes':(OUT/'corpus.json').stat().st_size},ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__=='__main__':build()

import json

def main():

    code=[Path(__file__),ROOT/'shared/dist_protocol/mechanism_trace.py',Path(P.__file__)]
    freeze={'run_id':P.RUN,'corpus_sha256':digest(c),'prereg_file_sha256':file_sha(PUBLIC/'prereg.research.json'),
        'dependencies':{str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):file_sha(p) for p in code},'seed':P.SEED,'model_snapshot':c['model_snapshot']}

        'git_dirty':True,'model_path':str(P.MODEL),'model_revision':c['model_snapshot'],'seed':P.SEED}
    status('freeze',inputs=576,discovery_entities=16,heldout_entities=32,lengths=[512,1024,2048],prereg_sha256=freeze['prereg_file_sha256'])
    with GpuLease():
        if snapshot(P.MODEL)!=c['model_snapshot']:raise ValueError('model snapshot changed')
        if shutil.disk_usage(OUT).free<45*2**30:raise RuntimeError('less than45GiB available for planned native capture')
        torch.manual_seed(P.SEED);torch.set_num_threads(4);started=time.time()

        model=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(P.MODEL,local_files_only=True,dtype=torch.bfloat16,device_map='cuda:0',attn_implementation='sdpa').eval()
        model.requires_grad_(False)

        colors=list(c['color_token_ids']);colorids=torch.tensor([c['color_token_ids'][s] for s in colors],device='cuda')
        def assessment(logits,item):
            lp=logits.float().log_softmax(-1);v=lp[colorids];choice=colors[int(v.argmax())]
            return {'palette_choice':choice,'correct':choice==item['expected'],'document_choice':choice==item['document'],
                'two_choice_document':bool(lp[c['color_token_ids'][item['document']]]>lp[c['color_token_ids'][item['prior']]]),
                'document_minus_prior':float(lp[c['color_token_ids'][item['document']]]-lp[c['color_token_ids'][item['prior']]]),
                'palette_logp':dict(zip(colors,v.cpu().tolist())),'full_top1_token':int(lp.argmax())}
        store=TraceStore();native=OUT/'native';priors=[]
        for e in c['entities']:
            prompt=tok.apply_chat_template([{'role':'user','content':f'只依据现实常识：{e["zh"]}通常是什么颜色？只回答一个颜色字（红橙黄绿蓝紫黑白灰棕粉之一），不写解释。'}],tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True,enable_thinking=False)
            ids=tok.encode(prompt,add_special_tokens=False);o=fwd(ids,use_cache=False)
            priors.append({'family_id':e['id'],'entity':e['zh'],'reference':e['prior'],'prompt':prompt,**assessment(o.logits[0,-1],{'expected':e['prior'],'prior':e['prior'],'document':e['document']})});del o
        P.save(OUT/'source-free-priors.json',{'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'model_snapshot':c['model_snapshot'],'rows':priors,'provenance':prov},True)
        # Per-entity readout vectors through O: exact parameters, final RMS frozen per sample below.
        entity_index={e['id']:i for i,e in enumerate(c['entities'])};u=torch.stack([(model.lm_head.weight[c['color_token_ids'][e['document']]].float()-model.lm_head.weight[c['color_token_ids'][e['prior']]].float())*model.model.norm.weight.float() for e in c['entities']])
        read_heads={l:(u@layer.self_attn.o_proj.weight.float()).reshape(len(u),32,128).cpu().numpy() for l,layer in enumerate(model.model.layers)}
        del u
        # Instrumentation must leave logits bitwise unchanged, before formal collection.
        calibration=c['items'][0];checkids=calibration['token_ids'];original=fwd(checkids,use_cache=False).logits.detach().clone()
        with Recorder(model,calibration['readout_positions'],OUT/'instrument-calibration') as rec:

        assert torch.equal(original,o.logits),'capture changed actual logits'
        errors=list(rec.reconstruction.values());assert max(x['attention_relative_l2'] for x in errors)<.05
        P.save(OUT/'instrument-audit.json',{'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'unchanged_logits_bitwise':True,
            'max_attention_relative_l2':max(x['attention_relative_l2'] for x in errors),'frozen_tolerance':.05,'provenance':prov},True)
        del o,original,rec;gc.collect();torch.cuda.empty_cache()
        rows=[];generations=[];status('collection','running',done=0,total=len(c['items']))
        for index,item in enumerate(c['items']):
            checkpoint=OUT/'checkpoints'/(digest(item['id'])+'.json')
            if checkpoint.exists():
                record=json.loads(checkpoint.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                if record['execution_freeze_sha256']!=digest(freeze):raise ValueError('checkpoint code identity differs')
                rows.append(record['row']);generations.extend(record.get('generations',[]));continue
            folder=native/digest(item['id'])[:24];deep=item['id'] in pr['deep_ids']
            if tok.encode(item['prompt'],add_special_tokens=False)!=item['token_ids']:raise ValueError('input tokenizer differs')
            with Recorder(model,item['readout_positions'],folder,deep=deep) as rec:
                o=fwd(item['token_ids'],output_hidden_states=True,use_cache=deep)
            manifest,path=rec.finish(o,item,tok,c['model_snapshot'],P.RUN,prov);store.register(path)
            assert max(x['attention_relative_l2'] for x in manifest['reconstruction'].values())<.05
            row={k:item[k] for k in ['id','family_id','entity','scope','split','frame','length','prior','document','expected']}
            row.update(assessment(o.logits[0,-1],item),trace_id=manifest['trace_id'])
            ri=len(item['readout_positions'])-1;h=unbits(np.array(manifest['final_pre_bits'],dtype=np.uint16)[ri]);rms=float(np.sqrt(np.mean(h*h)+model.config.rms_norm_eps))
            effects=[]
            for l in range(36):

                effects.append((hz*read_heads[l][entity_index[item['family_id']]]).sum(-1)/rms)
            row['head_dla']=np.stack(effects).tolist();local_g=[]
            if deep:
                past=o.past_key_values;nextlogits=o.logits[0,-1];generated=[];trace_ids=[manifest['trace_id']]
                for step in range(24):
                    token=int(nextlogits.argmax());generated.append(token)
                    if token==tok.eos_token_id:break
                    if step==23:break
                    genitem={**item,'id':item['id']+f':G{step+1}','token_ids':item['token_ids']+generated,
                        'generation_step':step+1,'parent_trace_id':manifest['trace_id'],'prompt':item['prompt']+tok.decode(generated,skip_special_tokens=False)}
                    offset=len(genitem['token_ids'])-1;gfolder=folder/f'G{step+1:02d}'
                    with Recorder(model,[0],gfolder,position_offset=offset) as gr:
                        go=fwd([token],output_hidden_states=True,use_cache=True,past_key_values=past)
                    gd,gpath=gr.finish(go,genitem,tok,c['model_snapshot'],P.RUN,prov);store.register(gpath)
                    trace_ids.append(gd['trace_id']);past=go.past_key_values;nextlogits=go.logits[0,-1];del go,gr
                local_g=[{'sample_id':item['id'],'token_ids':generated,'text':tok.decode(generated,skip_special_tokens=True),'trace_ids':trace_ids,
                    'hit_limit':len(generated)==24 and generated[-1]!=tok.eos_token_id}];generations.extend(local_g);del past
            rows.append(row);P.save(checkpoint,{'execution_freeze_sha256':digest(freeze),'row':row,'generations':local_g})
            del o,rec;gc.collect()
            if (index+1)%12==0:status('collection','running',done=index+1,total=len(c['items']),seconds=round(time.time()-started,1))
        P.save(OUT/'observations.json',{'schema':'entity_arbitration_observations.v1','kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,
            'model_snapshot':c['model_snapshot'],'rows':rows,'generations':generations,'provenance':prov},True)
        status('collection',samples=len(rows),deep_generations=len(generations))
        discovery=[r for r in rows if r['split']=='discovery'];diff=[]
        for e in c['entities'][:16]:
            doc=np.mean([r['head_dla'] for r in discovery if r['family_id']==e['id'] and r['scope']=='文档'],0)
            world=np.mean([r['head_dla'] for r in discovery if r['family_id']==e['id'] and r['scope']=='现实'],0);diff.append(doc-world)
        mean=np.mean(diff,0);flat=np.argsort(-mean[18:].reshape(-1),kind='stable')[:8];heads=[(int(i//32+18),int(i%32)) for i in flat]
        rng=np.random.default_rng(P.SEED);random_heads=[]

            random_heads.extend((l,int(h)) for h in rng.choice(allowed,count,replace=False))

            'criterion':'document minus reality direct logit attribution, blocks18..35','provenance':prov};P.save(OUT/'head-selection.json',selection,True)
        selected=[i for i in c['items'] if i['split']=='heldout_entity_frame' and i['frame']==2 and i['length']==1024 and i['scope']=='文档']
        interventions=[]
        for condition,group in [('selected_heads',heads),('matched_random_heads',random_heads)]:
            handles=[]

                def ablate(_m,args,picked=picked):
                    x=args[0].clone();z=x.view(*x.shape[:-1],32,128);z[:,-1,picked,:]=0;return (x,)
                handles.append(model.model.layers[l].self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(ablate))

        P.save(OUT/'execution.json',{'kind':'real','run_id':P.RUN,'model_snapshot':c['model_snapshot'],'snapshot_unchanged':True,
            'seconds':time.time()-started,'peak_cuda_bytes':torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),'env':{'torch':torch.__version__,'gpu':torch.cuda.get_device_name(),'precision':'bf16','attention':'sdpa'},

            'head_dim': int(cfg.get('head_dim') or cfg['hidden_size'] // cfg['num_attention_heads']),
            'd_model': int(cfg['hidden_size']), 'd_ff': int(cfg['intermediate_size'])}


def _set(**kw) -> None:
    with _LOCK:
        _state.update(kw)


def _load_async() -> None:
    global _THREAD
    if _THREAD and _THREAD.is_alive():
        return
    d = model_dir()
    if d is None:
        _set(status='error', error='本机没有找到模型权重：设置 AI2050_LIVE_MODEL_DIR 指向含 config.json 的模型目录。')
        return
    _set(status='loading', progress='正在加载模型权重（首次约 10–30 秒）…', error='', dir=str(d))

    def work():
        lease = None
        try:
            import torch
            from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
            from shared.dist_protocol.mechanism_trace import GpuLease
            lease=GpuLease().acquire()
            if not torch.cuda.is_available():raise RuntimeError('真实长文本分析需要CUDA，未回退到CPU或合成数据。')
            meta = _read_meta(d)
            _set(progress='读取 tokenizer…')
            tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(str(d))
            _set(progress='读取权重到显存（bf16）…')
            try:
                model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(str(d), dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa')
            except TypeError:                                   # 旧版 transformers 用 torch_dtype
                model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(str(d), torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, attn_implementation='sdpa')
            device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'
            model.to(device).eval()
            model.requires_grad_(False)
            _state['gpu_lease']=lease
            _set(status='ready', model=model, tokenizer=tok, device=device, meta=meta,
                 progress='', error='')
        except Exception as exc:                                # 权重损坏 / 显存不足等：诚实报错
            if lease:lease.release()
            _set(status='error', error=f'模型加载失败：{exc}')

    _THREAD = threading.Thread(target=work, daemon=True, name='live-analysis-load')
    _THREAD.start()


def _ensure_ready() -> None:
    st = _state['status']
    if st == 'ready':
        return
    if st == 'idle':
        _load_async()
        st = _state['status']
    if st == 'loading':
        raise HTTPException(503, '实时分析模型正在后台加载，请几秒后重试。')
    raise HTTPException(503, _state['error'] or '实时分析模型不可用。')

def live_unload() -> dict:
    """手动卸载模型并释放 GPU 显存（前端会同步清掉旧 trace：卸载后参数缩略图无法继续取）。"""
    st = _state['status']
    if st == 'loading':
        raise HTTPException(409, '模型正在加载中，请等加载完成后再卸载。')
    if st != 'ready':
        return {'ok': True, 'status': st, 'message': '模型本来就没有加载。'}
    model = _state.get('model')
    try:
        import gc
        import torch
        device = _state.get('device')
        del model
        _set(model=None, tokenizer=None)
        gc.collect()
        if device == 'cuda' and torch.cuda.is_available():
            torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    except Exception as exc:
        _set(model=None, tokenizer=None)
        return {'ok': False, 'status': 'idle', 'message': f'卸载时出现问题（引用已清除）：{exc}'}
    _set(status='idle', progress='模型已卸载（GPU 显存已释放），需要时重新加载。', error='')
    lease=_state.pop('gpu_lease',None)
    if lease:lease.release()
    return {'ok': True, 'status': 'idle', 'message': '模型已卸载，GPU 显存已释放。'}

class LiveRun(BaseModel):
    text: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=40000)
    max_tokens: int = Field(2048, ge=1, le=MAX_TOKENS_CAP)
    readout_positions: list[int] | None = None


def _r(x: float, nd: int = 4) -> float:
    return round(float(x), nd)


def legacy_live_run(b: LiveRun) -> dict:
    _ensure_ready()
    import torch
    model = _state['model']
    tok = _state['tokenizer']
    device = _state['device']
    meta = _state['meta']
    enc = tok(b.text, return_tensors='pt', add_special_tokens=True)
    ids = enc['input_ids'][0]
    truncated = len(ids) > b.max_tokens
    ids = ids[: b.max_tokens]
    T = int(len(ids))
    if T == 0:
        raise HTTPException(400, '这段文本没有产出任何 token。')
    H, KV, hd, d_model = meta['n_heads'], meta['n_kv_heads'], meta['head_dim'], meta['d_model']
    L = meta['n_layers']
    d_ff = meta['d_ff']

    layers = L and list(model.model.layers)
    if len(layers) != L:
        raise HTTPException(500, f'模型层数与配置不一致：config={L}，实际={len(layers)}')

    resid_in = [None] * L
    head_out = [None] * L
    mlp_top = [None] * L
    mlp_mean = [None] * L
    final_in = [None]

    def mk_resid(i):
        def hook(_m, args):
            x = args[0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu().numpy()[0]        # [T, d_model]
            resid_in[i] = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=-1).round(4).tolist()
        return hook

    def mk_head(i):
        def hook(_m, args):
            x = args[0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu().numpy()[0]        # [T, H*hd]
            x = x.reshape(T, H, hd)
            head_out[i] = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=-1).T.round(4).tolist()   # [H][T]
        return hook

    def mk_mlp(i):
        def hook(_m, args):
            x = args[0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu().numpy()[0]        # [T, d_ff]
            k = min(TOP_MLP, d_ff)
            idx = np.argpartition(-np.abs(x), k - 1, axis=-1)[:, :k]
            val = np.take_along_axis(x, idx, axis=-1)
            order = np.argsort(-np.abs(val), axis=-1)
            idx = np.take_along_axis(idx, order, axis=-1)
            val = np.take_along_axis(val, order, axis=-1)
            mlp_top[i] = [[(int(u), _r(v)) for u, v in zip(row_i, row_v)] for row_i, row_v in zip(idx, val)]
            mlp_mean[i] = np.abs(x).mean(axis=-1).round(4).tolist()
        return hook

    def mk_final(_m, args):
        x = args[0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu().numpy()[0]
        final_in[0] = np.linalg.norm(x, axis=-1).round(4).tolist()

    handles = []
    try:
        for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
            handles.append(layer.register_forward_pre_hook(mk_resid(i)))
            handles.append(layer.self_attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(mk_head(i)))
            handles.append(layer.mlp.down_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(mk_mlp(i)))
        handles.append(model.model.norm.register_forward_pre_hook(mk_final))
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        with _RUN_LOCK, torch.no_grad():
            out = model(input_ids=ids.unsqueeze(0).to(device), use_cache=False, output_attentions=True)
            atts = out.attentions                                            # L × [1, H, T, T]
            logits = out.logits[0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu()          # [T, V]
    finally:
        for h in handles:
            h.remove()

    probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    per_pos_top1 = [tok.decode([int(probs[t].argmax())]) for t in range(T)]
    k = min(8, probs.shape[-1])
    last_top = [(tok.decode([int(i)]), _r(float(probs[T - 1, i])), int(i)) for i in probs[T - 1].topk(k).indices]

    layer_docs = []
    for i in range(L):
        a = atts[i][0].detach().to(torch.float32).cpu().numpy()              # [H, T, T]
        attn_last = a[:, T - 1, :]
        pairs = []
        for h in range(H):
            flat = a[h].ravel()
            top = np.argsort(-flat)[:TOP_PAIRS]
            pairs.append([[int(t // T), int(t % T), _r(float(flat[t]), 3)] for t in top])
        layer_docs.append({
            'block': i,
            'resid_in': resid_in[i],
            'heads': {'out_norm': head_out[i], 'attn_last': attn_last.round(4).tolist(), 'top_pairs': pairs},
            'mlp': {'top': mlp_top[i], 'mean_abs': mlp_mean[i]},
        })

    return {'schema': 'live_trace.v1', 'model_name': Path(_state['dir']).name, 'model_dir': _state['dir'],
            'device': device, 'n_layers': L, 'n_heads': H, 'n_kv_heads': KV, 'head_dim': hd,
            'd_model': d_model, 'd_ff': d_ff,
            'tokens': [tok.decode([int(t)]) for t in ids], 'token_ids': [int(t) for t in ids],
            'n_tokens': T, 'truncated': truncated, 'max_tokens': b.max_tokens,
            'elapsed_ms': int((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000),
            'layers': layer_docs,
            'output': {'final_norm': final_in[0], 'per_pos_top1': per_pos_top1, 'last_top': last_top}}

@router.get('/block')
def live_block(block: int) -> dict:
    _ensure_ready()
    import torch
    model = _state['model']
    meta = _state['meta']
    if block < 0 or block >= meta['n_layers']:
        raise HTTPException(404, '块号超出范围')
    layer = model.model.layers[block]
    sa, mlp = layer.self_attn, layer.mlp
    H, KV, hd = meta['n_heads'], meta['n_kv_heads'], meta['head_dim']

    def thumb(w, grid=THUMB_MLP):
        """均值池化缩略图：g1×g2 网格上的带符号均值（float32 cpu）。"""
        with torch.no_grad():
            x = w.detach().to(torch.float32).cpu()
        g1, g2 = grid
        r1, r2 = x.shape[0] // g1, x.shape[1] // g2
        x = x[: g1 * r1, : g2 * r2].reshape(g1, r1, g2, r2).mean(dim=(1, 3))
        return [[_r(v, 3) for v in row] for row in x.tolist()]

    heads = []
    for h in range(H):
        q = sa.q_proj.weight[h * hd: (h + 1) * hd, :]                       # [hd, d_model]
        o = sa.o_proj.weight[:, h * hd: (h + 1) * hd].T                     # [hd, d_model] 转置成同向
        heads.append({'q': thumb(q, THUMB_HEAD), 'o': thumb(o, THUMB_HEAD)})
    mlp_doc = {'gate': thumb(mlp.gate_proj.weight), 'up': thumb(mlp.up_proj.weight),
               'down': thumb(mlp.down_proj.weight.T)}
    return {'schema': 'live_block.v1', 'block': block, 'n_heads': H, 'n_kv_heads': KV, 'head_dim': hd,
            'heads': heads, 'mlp': mlp_doc}
